title: Odin, 5 dollars

specs.Decoration: high relief, antique finish, selective gilding, resin fill

descriptionPlain: Description Lord of Valhalla immortalized in pure silver Two ounces of the finest silver A modern approach to a traditional subject High relief and attention to detail Created for fans of tales and myths Odin is the god of wisdom, magic, power, and war. His inseparable attributes are raven, wolf and the Gungnir spear with magical runes carved on it. Unique artistic expression of his image guarantee that the “Odin” will be a true god among people fascinated with ancient mythology.
